prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Build a website with AI(chatgpt, dalle, mid-journey) integration and SaaS. + Full website design
We are looking for someone to build a website with AI(chatgpt, dalle, mid-journey) integration and SaaS. + Full website design. The website will be associated with restaurants and food. What we need: -Design and implement a high-quality website from scratch, including full website design -Integrate AI capabilities using ChatGPT, Dalle, and mid-journey -Ensure the website has a user-friendly interface and provides a seamless user experience -Develop and implement SaaS functionality, including subscription-based access and billing management -Ensure the website is optimized for speed and scalability, with a focus on security and reliability -Test and debug the website to ensure its functionality and performance meet high standards. If you have done something similar that would be a big plus. Also please attach websites you did similar to this one.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Subscription box billing backend
client: Fernwood Pantry
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2025-07
end: 2025-10
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Node.js
- NestJS
- PostgreSQL
- Stripe Billing
- BullMQ
implied_skills:
- recurring billing
- background jobs
built: Moved subscribers off a legacy plugin onto Stripe Billing with a retry queue
  for failed card payments.
metrics:
- 6.5k subscribers migrated
- 31% of failed payments recovered

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Subscription box billing backend (p18).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I can design and build your restaurant and food SaaS website from scratch, including a polished UI, AI integration, and subscription-based access with billing. I’ve built a subscription box billing backend for Fernwood Pantry, where I moved 6.5k subscribers to Stripe Billing and recovered 31% of failed payments through a retry queue.

I focus on creating fast, scalable, secure, and reliable products, and I’m comfortable handling both frontend experience and backend SaaS logic. I’d be happy to help you build something modern and user-friendly.

What kind of AI workflows do you want most on the site: content generation, image creation, or both?
